metadata.question: Was nighttime light intensity lower on March 24, 2019, compared to March 9, 2019, in Beira and Manga, Mozambique?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) - "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" for monthly composites, or "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1/VIIRS_DNB_Daily" for daily data - Since we need specific dates (March 24 and March 9, 2019), I should use daily data if available, or monthly if daily doesn't exist - Actually, VIIRS DNB daily data exists: "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1" or similar - Let me use the monthly composite "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" but filter for March 2019, though this won't give us daily differences - Better: Use "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2" (daily) or check what's available - Most reliable: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG" for monthly, but we need daily - Let me use a workaround: Check if there's significant difference in the general timeframe, or use available daily products 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we typically don't mask clouds in the traditional sense, but the data comes with quality flags - Use quality bands to filter out poor quality observations - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights 3. Logic: - Compare average nighttime light intensity for the two dates - If data shows lower intensity on March 24 vs March 9 → A (Yes) - If data shows equal or higher intensity on March 24 → B (No) - Handle missing data cases (C1, C2, C3) Note: Beira and Manga are cities in Mozambique that were affected by Cyclone Idai around March 14-15, 2019. This context suggests we're looking for evidence of reduced nighttime lights after the cyclone. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations: Beira and Manga, Mozambique const beira = ee.Geometry.Point([34.8389, -19.8436]); const manga = ee.Geometry.Point([34.8167, -20.0000]); const region = ee.Geometry.MultiPoint([beira, manga]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around both cities // Define dates const date1 = '2019-03-09'; const date2 = '2019-03-24'; // Try VIIRS DNB monthly composite (most reliable for nighttime lights) const collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(region) .select('avg_rad'); // Average radiance band // Get March 2019 image const marchImg = collection.filter(ee.Filter.date('2019-03-01', '2019-03-31')).first(); // Check if image exists const imgCheck = await new Promise((resolve) => { marchImg.getInfo((result, error) => { resolve(result !== null && !error); }); }); if (!imgCheck) { console.log('No VIIRS monthly data for March 2019.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Since monthly data doesn't give us daily resolution, let's try daily VIIRS data // Use VNP46A2 daily product if available const dailyCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2') .filterBounds(region) .select('DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL'); const img1 = dailyCollection.filter(ee.Filter.date(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day'))).mosaic(); const img2 = dailyCollection.filter(ee.Filter.date(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day'))).mosaic(); // Calculate mean nighttime light intensity for both dates const stats1Promise = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: region, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2Promise = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: region, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats1 = await stats1Promise; const stats2 = await stats2Promise; const mean1 = stats1.DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL_mean; const count1 = stats1.DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL_count; const mean2 = stats2.DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL_mean; const count2 = stats2.DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL_count; console.log(`March 9: Mean=${mean1}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`March 24: Mean=${mean2}, Pixels=${count2}`); // Validation if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log('Calculation resulted in null/NaN values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: Was March 24 lower than March 9? if (mean2 < mean1) { console.log(`March 24 intensity (${mean2.toFixed(3)}) < March 9 (${mean1.toFixed(3)})`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`March 24 intensity (${mean2.toFixed(3)}) >= March 9 (${mean1.toFixed(3)})`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
